_readme.purpose: Machine-readable field→schema map for the Overhaul feature, meant to be consumed by a Figma-generation plugin so it can attach backend provenance (table.column) as plugin data on generated nodes.
_readme.how_to_match: Join on 'field_key'. field_key is taken verbatim from the prototype's TS source (prop/state/variable names) — if your Figma-gen plugin derives frames/inputs from this same source, the generated layer names should already carry these keys (or very close to them). Recommended convention: when generating a node for a form field, set node name or pluginData key 'schema-field' = field_key, then look it up here and write pluginData 'schema-table', 'schema-column', 'schema-status' onto that node.

status_values.match: backend column exists and means the same thing
status_values.partial: backend column exists but semantics/shape differ (see notes)
status_values.gap: no backend column/table at all for this UI field — confirm with BA before writing AC
status_values.external: sourced from vms_mas_vehicle / vms_mas_department / HR platform — not owned by maintain-d-be

_readme.critical_finding: Two competing prototype directions exist for Overhaul (plan-form 'v1' under /overhaul/* and vehicle-execution 'v2' under /overhaul-v2/*). The REAL backend migrations (dated 2026-10-19, newer than both prototypes) diverge from BOTH: it added WBS/Network/Activity/mandatory-document fields that neither prototype has, and dropped vehicle-selection-criteria, per-vehicle step lifecycle, parts requisition, inspection logs, and safety/warranty tracking that both prototypes assume. Confirm which prototype direction is still in scope before generating more Figma screens from it.

fields.label_th: ชื่อแผนงาน
ปีแผนงาน (พ.ศ.)
fields.notes: UI stores พ.ศ. 4-digit int; backend column fiscal_year is varchar(10) validated by a 4-digit regex (domain/overhaul/domain/appointment.go fiscalYearPattern) — same shape, but confirm พ.ศ. vs ค.ศ. convention end-to-end.

fields.label_th: งบประมาณ (บาท)
fields.notes: backend stores as integer (baht, no decimals) — UI formats with .toLocaleString; confirm decimal places get dropped intentionally.

fields.label_th: เลขที่แผน
fields.notes: Generated server-side. Prototype format 'OVH-2569-0004' (see overhaulV2.ts) DOES NOT match real backend format 'ORZ690000X' (FormatPlanNo in overhaul_plan.go:292). Figma mockups showing 'OVH-...' numbers are wrong — use ORZ format or make it clearly a placeholder.

fields.label_th: เลือกรถเข้าแผน + เกณฑ์คัดเลือก
fields.notes: OverhaulPlan Go struct has NO vehicles field and no selection_criteria at all. Real backend attaches vehicles to a plan only indirectly, through vms_trn_po_vehicle (vehicle ↔ purchase order), which happens later at PO-entry time — not at plan-creation time. If AC says 'เลือกรถตอนสร้างแผน' it currently has no column to persist that selection to.

fields.label_th: เลข WBS / Network / Activity
fields.notes: Backend REQUIRES these 3 fields (validatePlanFields in overhaul_plan.go) but neither prototype's PlanForm has input fields for them. Must add to Figma/AC or the create-plan API call will always fail validation.

fields.label_th: เอกสารอนุมัติหลักการ / เอกสารอนุมัติงบประมาณ
fields.notes: Backend requires at least 1 file of each of the first two doc_types to create/update a plan (CreateOverhaulPlanCommand.Validate). Neither PlanForm.tsx nor the v2 flow has a file-upload step at plan level — this is a hard blocker for the create-plan API, not optional.

fields.label_th: สถานะแผน + อนุมัติโดยหัวหน้า
fields.notes: Column is free varchar(50), only 1 seeded constant found in code (PlanStatusPendingApproval = 'pending_approval'). The full DRAFT/PENDING/ACTIVE/CLOSING/CLOSED/CANCELLED state machine + approver/reject-reason fields that PlanForm.tsx assumes are NOT modeled as columns anywhere (no approved_by, approved_at, reject_reason, close_* columns on vms_trn_overhaul_job). Approval workflow shown in UI is currently unbacked.

fields.label_th: ทะเบียน / ยี่ห้อ-รุ่น / หน่วยงาน / วันจดทะเบียน
fields.backend_column: license_plate / brand_model / org_unit / registration_date (names approximate — confirm with main-be schema)

fields.label_th: รหัสข้างรถ
fields.notes: Not confirmed to exist on vms_mas_vehicle from anything visible in maintain-d-be — must verify with main-be team.

fields.label_th: ผู้ดูแลรถ (เจ้าของรถ) / เบอร์โทร
fields.notes: No 'owner' concept found on vms_mas_vehicle or anywhere in maintain-d-be migrations. Used heavily in StepAppt for 'ผู้รับรถ' — needs a real source before AC can specify where it comes from.

fields.screen: ① เบิกอะไหล่ (/overhaul-v2/[vehicleId])
fields.field_key: parts[].code / name / unit / qty / stock / price
fields.label_th: รายการอะไหล่ / คงคลัง / จำนวนเบิก / ราคาต่อหน่วย
fields.notes: There is NO parts/requisition table scoped to overhaul anywhere in migrations. vms_mas_part + vms_trn_part_requisition exist but are FK'd to vms_trn_repair_job only, not to vms_trn_overhaul_job or vms_trn_purchase_order. This entire step has zero backend support today.

fields.screen: ① เบิกอะไหล่
fields.label_th: ข้ามขั้นเบิกอะไหล่

fields.label_th: บริษัทผู้รับจ้าง
fields.notes: vendor_address/telephone/mobile_phone were added later (migrations 20261021100000, 20261021110000) — present if those migrations are applied.

fields.screen: ② บันทึก PO
fields.label_th: เลขที่ PO
fields.notes: Real backend auto-generates po_number via FormatPONumber = '{overhaul_code}-{seq}' (purchase_order.go:216), e.g. ORZ6900001-01. Prototype placeholder 'PO-2569-xxxxx' is user-typed free text — decide whether PO number stays user-entered or becomes system-generated before writing AC.

fields.screen: ② บันทึก PO
fields.label_th: วันที่ PO / วันเริ่มสัญญา / ระยะเวลาว่าจ้าง / วันสิ้นสุดสัญญา
fields.notes: vms_trn_purchase_order has NO date columns at all (only created_at/updated_at audit timestamps). Contract date range is a core part of the UI (drives 'เกินสัญญา' badge) but has nowhere to persist today.

fields.label_th: รายการงานที่บริษัทรับทำ
fields.notes: No column for a list of scope-of-work line items on vms_trn_purchase_order. po_name (varchar) could hold one line but not a structured list.

fields.label_th: งบประมาณ (ของ PO นี้)
fields.notes: vms_trn_purchase_order has no amount/budget column — only the PLAN-level approved_budget exists (vms_trn_overhaul_job.approved_budget), which is a single total, not per-PO.

fields.label_th: สถานะ PO (กำลังดำเนินการ/เสร็จแล้ว) / วันที่ส่งมอบ
fields.notes: No status or completion-date column on vms_trn_purchase_order. The 'ส่งมอบงานแล้ว' action in the UI has nothing to write to.

fields.screen: ③ ติดตามงาน (/overhaul-v2/[vehicleId])
fields.field_key: logs[] (date, progress%, poId, note, inspector, files[])
fields.label_th: บันทึกการตรวจงาน
fields.notes: No inspection-log table exists for overhaul anywhere in migrations. Entire step unbacked.

fields.screen: ④ นัดหมายรับรถ (/overhaul-v2/[vehicleId])
fields.field_key: poId / date / time / contact / tel / note
fields.label_th: สถานที่รับรถ (บริษัท) / วันที่นัด / เวลา / ผู้ประสานงานของบริษัท / เบอร์โทร / รายละเอียดเพิ่มเติม
fields.backend_column: po_vehicle_uid, appointment_start_date/end_date, coordinator_* or garage_* (needs mapping decision), person_full_name/dept_sap/emp_id
fields.notes: Real table models appointment_type IN ('intake','return') with DATE-only start/end (no time-of-day column) and a generic coordinator/person/employee identity triple whose semantics don't cleanly match 'ผู้ประสานงานของบริษัท'. Needs a BA session to decide which real column plays which UI role before AC can be precise.

fields.screen: ④ นัดหมายรับรถ
fields.label_th: ส่งนัดหมายเมื่อ / วันที่เจ้าของรถรับรถจริง
fields.backend_column: has_responded (bool), is_approved (bool) — no explicit picked_up_at timestamp
fields.notes: pickedUpAt is the date that starts the warranty clock per overhaulV2.ts comments — real table has no column that unambiguously represents 'the day the vehicle was physically picked up'. This is load-bearing for warranty math, needs a dedicated column.

fields.label_th: Safety Inspection Checklist
fields.notes: No safety-inspection table exists for overhaul. SAFETY_ITEMS (12 fixed rows) in overhaulV2.ts are hardcoded in frontend — comment in that file explicitly flags 'ค่าจำลอง รอ กบค. ส่งแบบฟอร์มจริง'.

fields.label_th: ใบ checklist ที่ลงนามแล้ว / ผู้ตรวจ
จำนวนวันรับประกัน / วันเริ่ม / วันสิ้นสุด / วันปิดงาน
fields.notes: No warranty_* or closed_at columns anywhere for overhaul. This directly contradicts the TOR's own warranty requirement (180 days post-Overhaul per JO1-Tech-Data-Spec.md section 6.3/7.4.2-04) — the TOR expects this to be tracked, but today's schema has nowhere to put it.
